'''Sreeharlo''' was a location on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dressel/Legends|Dressel]] that was led by a governor. [[Orrimaarko/Legends|Orrimaarko]] served as governor of Sreeharlo before joining the [[Dressellian resistance]].<ref name="Stay on Target" />
